# PDF Page Fragment Table

This table exercises full-buffer column sizing and PDF page-fragment
continuation framing.

| Category | What it sells | Where it fits | Why the new role is different |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Resource consultancy | Human capacity | Known role, known stack, known rate, known structure | Adds people to the existing production model |
| Specialist consultancy | Deep expertise | Known technical problem requiring expert intervention | Solves a defined problem rather than changing the production loop |
| AI coaching | Tool enablement | Training, prompting, adoption support, inspiration | Improves usage without necessarily changing throughput, verification, integration, or measurement |
| Management consultancy | Strategic diagnosis and recommendations | Executive alignment, operating model theory, transformation roadmap | Often separates analysts from production proof |
| Fractional CTO | Part-time senior technology leadership | Startup, scaleup, or SME that needs CTO-level leadership without a full-time executive | Broader mandate: technology strategy, roadmap, architecture, team, hiring, governance, vendor choices, and CEO or board support. The new role is narrower and more intervention-oriented: it changes the production loop and proves AI-augmented production capability through verified state change |
| AI Transformation and Operating Model Lead | Changed production capability | AI adoption has begun, but value capture is constrained by workflow, verification, integration, and accountability gaps | Bridges strategy, execution, architecture, proof, and operating-model change |
